builds.baseline: c431fb274303251742840b1dd29255c554edb901 plus verified Latin-1 checkpoint changes; identical to the production DLL from the Latin-1 report.

method.timing: Finalized EiffelStudio x64 production DLLs, assertions off, and MSVC Release libexpat 2.8.1. Six rounds. Single-threaded stock fair_speed.exe reads the fixture before timing and includes parser create, XML_Parse and free in each iteration. The Python parent pins all timed processes to the same Windows logical CPU. Each DLL and case has one warm-up parse and a calibrated iteration count. Seeded case order and all six permutations of the three DLLs per case. Time is the median of six round means; speedup is the median of six within-round before/after ratios.
method.counters: A separately instrumented DLL logs the number of entries in each inherited table copied and each binding declaration in the baseline, or each declaration installed and reverted in the candidate. Timings and stack profiles use the uninstrumented DLLs. The old clone routine was removed in the candidate. Physical counts were checked against an independent traversal of the fixture. Callback-off checksums are always zero; callbacks-on runs verify nonzero name, attribute and text hashes.
method.stack_sampling: Same uninstrumented DLLs as timing. The sampler uses the stock benchmark on its main thread and another thread to unwind that benchmark thread only, nominally every 1 ms in the timer window. Each frame is resolved from its module-relative address through that image's MSVC MAP; generated C names map back to Eiffel features. For xpact, the executable .text and unwind .pdata section RVA, size and SHA-256 match a relink of its production objects with /MAP. The sampler runs separately from timings. Inclusive counts use distinct stacks per feature; caller-callee counts overlap. Inlined work is attributed to the enclosing frame.
profile_reproduction: In an x64 MSVC environment compile profile/sample.c: cl /nologo /O2 profile/sample.c /Fe:sample.exe /link /MAP:sample.map psapi.lib winmm.lib.

Link each DLL with its MSVC /MAP output. From the finalized EiffelStudio build, retain EIFGENs/xpact_native_library/F_code to resolve generated symbols. The namespace fixtures supplied to sample.exe are generated by repeat_timings.write_fixtures.
sample.exe <DLL> <fixture.xml> <chunk_bytes> <callbacks> <namespaces> <timed_parses> <stacks.tsv>. Each record lists the actual timed_parses; frames are leaf-first and addresses are module-relative.

python profile/summarize.py <stacks.tsv> --map sample.exe=sample.map --map xpact.dll=xpact.map --fcode <F_code> --json symbols.json. For Expat substitute --map libexpat.dll=libexpat.map and omit --fcode.

For work counts, apply the corresponding instrumentation patch to its own clean source snapshot, rebuild using scripts/build_native_eiffel.ps1 and run fair_speed.exe with one parse per case. NSCOPE clone N records one table and N inherited key/value pairs. NSCOPE declare/restore count per-declaration work.
method.scope: UTF-8 stock namespace document, same bytes with processing on/off, active/disabled application callbacks, whole/4 KiB/256-byte calls; two 32-binding synthetic cases with 600 branches, eight nested elements per branch and four children; UTF-8 elements and prior Latin-1 controls.
